[Trend Position]

· Approaching SMA100 ($1,917.07) resistance, below SMA200 ($2,073.79) — Mid-to-long term trend shows bearish bias.
· 52-week position (11.7%) — High level relative to historical lows, significant decline from highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (50.6 → 56.1) — Neutral zone sustained, confirmed sideways movement after exiting oversold.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-5.3104 → -7.0059) — Bearish trend continues, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $1,888.19) — Bandwidth narrowed to 6.60%, indicating a lack of directional momentum.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($1,897.33) — Support zone based on Pivot Point (PP $1,896.81).
· Swing Resistance ($1,944.16) — Upside potential upon breaking SMA100 ($1,917.07) and 5-day high ($1,921.86).
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern — Sideways pattern confirmed, no Higher Low or Lower High formation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.33x) — Increased compared to previous average, enhancing confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis — Accumulation phase continues, 4H RSI rose but daily MACD worsening prevents multi-timeframe alignment. Conditions for maintaining a wait-and-see approach are met.
